response.justification: Highly qualified full-stack engineer with 15+ years of experience, currently Staff Software Engineer at re:cinq. Demonstrates strong alignment with core requirements: TypeScript, Node.js, React, AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and notably—direct AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling expertise in current role. Primary concern is lack of explicit Nest.js and specific testing framework mentions, though technical breadth and seniority suggest rapid capability to master these frameworks.
strengths: 15+ years full-stack experience with clear Staff-level progression; currently leads AI-agent infrastructure work directly addressing emerging job requirements
Proven expertise in core tech stack: TypeScript, Node.js, React, AWS CDK, plus strong backend capabilities; exceeds mid-senior level requirement
Demonstrated software craftsmanship culture: created testing frameworks (Fluent-Asserts, Trial), advocates TDD, maintains open-source projects, and leads architecture decisions
concerns: Nest.js framework—a primary stack requirement—is not mentioned; relies on general Node.js expertise to quickly acquire this specific framework
